integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames the young East Asian woman shown in <Picture 1>, seated at the outdoor café table in her white camisole with a thin gold necklace, preserving her identity, dark brown short hair, posture, the latte cup on the table, the rattan chair, and the vintage stone buildings, café tables, and pedestrians on the stone-paved street behind her. The camera holds a static shot as she lifts the latte with her right hand, takes a slow, gentle sip, and lowers her gaze with a calm expression. [Shot 2] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a slightly closer angle as something off-screen draws her attention; she abruptly sets the cup down on the saucer with a soft clink, pushes the rattan chair back with a scrape, and rises from the table in one swift motion. [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera switches to a tracking shot, following her from behind as she runs off toward the bridge, her hair and the hem of her white camisole flowing in the wind, weaving past pedestrians and café tables as the street opens toward the sunlit riverbank, her pace quickening.
overall_soundscape: Gentle café ambience with muffled chatter over the stone street. The porcelain cup clinks onto the saucer, the rattan chair scrapes across the stone, and her footsteps quicken with the rustle of fabric as she runs.

overall_soundscape: Bustling market ambience with overlapping vendor calls, footsteps on damp concrete, the crinkle of plastic bags, and the rustle of vegetable leaves.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, the woman shown in <Picture 1> stands at the center of an ancient Chinese water-town street, preserving her orange-red embroidered hanfu, ornate hair bun with pearl ornaments and metal hairpins, pearl earrings, jade pendant necklace, red silk sash, wooden round fan in her right hand, and embroidered cloth shoes. A medium-wide shot frames her from slightly behind the shoulder, with white-walled black-tiled houses, upturned eaves, and red lanterns lining the cobblestone street behind her. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she takes her first step forward, her long skirt and red sash swaying gently with the motion. Around her, crowds of passersby in hanfu and ancient-style robes walk past in both directions, their sleeves and hems flowing. She lifts her gaze, glances curiously at the shop fronts, and slowly brings the wooden fan up near her chest, fanning it lightly.
overall_soundscape: Soft footsteps on cobblestone, flowing fabric rustling, distant vendor calls, low murmur of the crowd, and a gentle breeze.
non_diegetic_music: A slow guzheng melody with soft bamboo flute lines, maintaining a gentle, unhurried tempo.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, continuing directly from the previous group as a single unbroken shot, the same woman in orange-red embroidered hanfu keeps walking forward, her hair bun with pearl ornaments, metal hairpins, pearl earrings, jade pendant necklace, red silk sash, wooden round fan, and embroidered cloth shoes unchanged. The camera maintains its slow push-in, now at a medium close-up tracking behind her as she weaves through the crowd of hanfu-clad pedestrians. She turns her head slightly toward a lantern-lined shopfront, pauses her fan near her lips with a faint smile, then steps around a child in a small red hanfu and continues on. Her long skirt and red sash flow as she walks, passersby parting naturally around her. The camera eases into a final over-the-shoulder composition as she advances toward the arched stone bridge ahead, the warm golden light catching the pearl hairpin.
overall_soundscape: Footsteps continue on the cobblestones, the crowd murmur and distant water-boat calls persist, with the soft whisper of fabric and a light breeze near the canal.
non_diegetic_music: The guzheng and flute melody continues seamlessly, gently resolving and fading out at the bridge.
